title: Implement a demand-gap gate
prompt: Compute a toy normalized gap max(demand-supply,0)/max(demand,1), gated by minimum support and a supplied threshold. Return score and reason ('low_support','below_threshold','gap'). Inputs are finite nonnegative scalars; this is an explicit practice rule, not an undocumented business formula.
